notes:
I found three options, but none of the pages I read gave a winter day, time or price.

- **Naperville Gymnastics, Parent & Tot.** 
The club's page lists it for toddlers ages 18-36 months, or 3-year-olds who need their parents' support.
 The page links to a schedule and registration, but I couldn't read the winter times or the fee.
- **The Little Gym of Naperville, parent-child classes.** 
Classes run from 4 months old to getting ready for preschool.
 
A parent or caregiver must take part for children under 3.
 No winter schedule or price came up.
- **Naperville Park District, Gym Kittens with Parent.** I only found this in the district's Spring 2023 guide, which listed it for 
ages 1-2
. That is an old listing, so I can't say it is running this winter. 
The 2026-2027 Winter Program Guide goes up on the park district's website December 2, and residents can register starting December 7.
